name: NHL Edge / api-web
tagline: Official NHL public stats and game data API used by NHL.com and NHL Edge products.
description: Public JSON API (api-web.nhle.com) providing NHL schedules, standings, boxscores, play-by-play, player and team stats, and game-state data powering NHL.com and NHL Edge. Widely used by developers as an unofficial but stable, unauthenticated web API; no official public developer portal or paid product is published.

auth.details: No API key or OAuth required for public read endpoints; calls are unauthenticated HTTPS GETs. Rate limiting may apply at the edge; no self-serve developer signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No published free-tier quotas; public endpoints appear free to call without signup

use_cases: get today's NHL scoreboard and live game states
fetch a team's season schedule and results
pull current league standings by conference or division
get detailed boxscore and play-by-play for a game ID
look up player game log and season stats by player ID
